tools.name: color_convert
tools.description: Convert a color between formats: hex (#RRGGBB), RGB, HSL, and CMYK. Use for questions like 'what is #ff5733 in HSL' or 'convert rgb(255,100,50) to hex'.

color.description: A color value in any of these formats: hex (#ff5733, #FF5733, or ff5733), RGB (rgb(255, 87, 51) or 255,87,51), HSL (hsl(15, 100%, 60%) or 15,100,60), or named CSS color (red, navy, coral). Case-insensitive.

tools.name: color_scheme
tools.description: Generate a color harmony from a base color. Returns complementary, triadic, analogous, split-complementary, square, and monochromatic schemes. Use for questions like 'what colors go well with #3498db' or 'suggest a color palette based on coral'.

color.description: Base color in any format (hex, RGB, HSL, or name)

scheme.description: Color scheme type (default: 'all' to show all schemes)

tools.name: color_name
tools.description: Get the closest named CSS color for a given hex/RGB value. Use for questions like 'what is this color: #8B4513' (returns 'SaddleBrown').

color.description: A color value in hex or RGB format
